serialize_to_html_string: serialize an ElementTree element and its children to a string of HTML5 markup
serialize_to_xhtml_string: serialize an ElementTree element and its children to a string of XHTML markup
escape_cdata: escape character data by replacing ampersands, less than, and greater than symbols with HTML entities
escape_attrib: escape attribute values by replacing special characters including quotes and newlines with HTML entities
review_serialization_logic: review the _serialize_html function to understand how ElementTree elements are recursively rendered to HTML or XHTML
